name: Quacky
official_context: A movable duck bot powered by a BO motor through a simple circuit.
verified_facts: Quacky is a movable duck bot powered by a BO motor through a simple circuit.
Quacky transforms chemical energy from batteries into electrical energy and mechanical movement.
Quacky demonstrates electronic cause and effect through simple motor control.

learning_materials.beginner: Quacky waddles and moves when electricity flows from the battery into its motor!
learning_materials.intermediate: Connecting Quacky's circuit sends current through the BO motor coil, creating a magnetic force that spins gears and waddles Quacky.
learning_materials.advanced: Energy conversion in Quacky: Battery chemical potential -> electrical current -> electromagnetic induction -> mechanical motion.
